target_group.value: All small, marginal, and landholding farmer families with cultivable land in operational possession.

eligibility_status.value: ELIGIBLE (All landholding and exclusion checks passed)

benefits.value: Direct bank transfer of ₹6,000 per year delivered in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000.

documents.value: Aadhaar Card, Land Record of Rights (Khatauni), and Aadhaar-seeded Bank Account with e-KYC.

application_process.value: Online registration via pmkisan.gov.in portal or assisted submission at nearest CSC center.

limitations.value: Excludes institutional landholders, income tax payees, and government pensioners receiving over ₹10,000/mo.

target_group.value: Farmers cultivating notified crops in notified insurance units (loanee and non-loanee growers).

eligibility_status.value: ELIGIBLE (Crop sown in notified district under notified seasonal window)

benefits.value: Comprehensive risk insurance covering prevented sowing, standing crop loss, post-harvest losses, and localized calamities.

max_benefit_inr.value: Sum insured up to cost of cultivation per hectare (variable based on scale of finance)

documents.value: Sowing Certificate / Patwari report, Land Possession Certificate / RoR, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.

application_process.value: Apply via National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), commercial bank branches, or CSC within cut-off date.

limitations.value: Losses due to war, nuclear risks, malicious damage, and preventable pest attacks are excluded.

target_group.value: Individual/joint owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers.

eligibility_status.value: ELIGIBLE (Eligible farmer with cultivable land records)

benefits.value: Revolving credit line for crop cultivation expenses at subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum (with prompt repayment incentive).

max_benefit_inr.value: Collateral-free credit limit up to ₹1,60,000; scale-of-finance limits up to ₹3,00,000 at 4% effective interest

documents.value: Filled application form, Land ownership records / tenancy agreement, Identity proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Pan card.

application_process.value: Apply at rural/commercial bank branches, Cooperative Banks, Regional Rural Banks, or through online portal.

limitations.value: Defaults on existing agricultural loans disqualify applicant until restructured or cleared.

insights.text: PM-KISAN offers unconditional liquidity of ₹6,000 directly to landholder accounts, whereas PMFBY acts as insurance protection against weather hazards.
Kisan Credit Card (KCC) provides working capital at 4% effective interest up to ₹3,00,000, creating operational synergy when paired with PM-KISAN cash transfers.
All three schemes accept Aadhaar and Land Records (Khatauni) as primary identification, streamlining document verification across services.

evidence.text: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme provides an income support of Rs. 6000/- per year to all farmer families across the country in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs. 2000/- each.
PMFBY provides comprehensive crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages.
Short-term crop loans up to Rs. 3 lakh are extended at a benchmark 7% interest rate with 3% prompt repayment incentive, reducing the effective rate to 4% p.a.
